title: Ridgeline 2P Alpine Tent
description: A four-season, two-person tent with a storm-ready aluminium frame, two vestibules and a snow-shedding dome built for shoulder-season ridgelines.

title: Summit 65L Expedition Pack
description: A load-carrying pack with an adjustable torso, hip-belt pockets and a waterproof base for long days above the treeline.

title: Cinder 15°F Down Sleeping Bag
description: 800-fill responsibly sourced down, a draft collar and a full-length two-way zip. Warm when it counts, packs to the size of a loaf.

title: Kindle Canister Stove Kit
description: A compact canister stove with a wide pot support and fine simmer control, packed with a non-stick pan for real camp breakfasts.

title: Trailmark 400 Headlamp
description: A rechargeable 400-lumen headlamp with an aluminium body, red night mode and a lockout so it never switches on in your pack.

title: Oakleaf Heavyweight Flannel
description: Brushed organic cotton flannel cut for layering at camp, with a longer back hem and reinforced elbows.
